full_judgment: 12. On hearing the learned Senior Advocates of both the sides and on penisal of the materials on record, including the judgments of all the Courts it appears that admittedly the suit land along with other lands belonged to Abdul Gani Siddique and his wife Somedonnessa, whose names were recorded in SA Khatian Nos. 94, 97 and 99(Exhibits 1/Kha Series). After the death of Abdul Gani, his wife Somedonnessa became the owner and possessor of the entire property. Her two sons Abdus Sattar and Abdul Majid died long before and as such Somedonnessa distributed her entire properties amongst the living sons, daughter, grandson and granddaughter through her deceased sons, by registered wasiatnama No. 425 dated 7.4.1960 (Exhibit No.2). The plaintiff/pre-emptor (respondent No.1 in both the civil petitions) claims that in view of the aforesaid wasiatnama and by inheritance he is a co-sharer tenant in the case jote. It is claimed that daughters of late Abdus Sattar also gifted their saham, which they got from the case jote by way of the said wasiatnama, to the plaintiff. Accordingly the plaintiff/pre-emptor claimed that in order to frustrate his right of pre-emption the defendants created the said exchange deed which is actually out and out a sale deed.
